lighting.limitations: Physical source values exported; disk/rectangle shape, area-light shadows, indirect bounce and radiometric/photometric engine calibration are approximations requiring the runtime visual check.

uvPolicy: Native UVs are unchanged and repeat. These Blender tile PNGs require TextureLoader flipY=true; no glTF V conversion was applied.
lightmapPolicy: The exported Blender Base Color graph is authoritative; no additional native lightmap is multiplied by the runtime.
